title: CF: plain-English database-day runbook with mandatory stop gates
public_pr_body:
Adds a plain-English database-day runbook with a STOP after every backup/restore, preflight, release, permission, wipe/import, reconciliation and browser gate. Required order is verified 138, JNR-required 140 and 141, verified 144, then 145 and 146. Explains that the frozen test fixture chronology does not independently prove the actual upgrade order.

Assumption: Code rehearses on an independently identified disposable restore first; real work always requires separate review. Every command is documentation only. No SQL was executed by this job. A 146 rollback keeps history/key_source and requires STOP, not reinstall on the same database. #207, exact #250 wipe and unrun independent proofs remain blockers.

Checks: 18 referenced paths and explicit order/146 stop rule checked; git diff --check passes. Documentation-only addition; no tests weakened. Full branch checks are recorded in CI job. Coordination #271.

- [x] CF ordered runbook and stop rules
- [ ] Actual same-commit backup/restore, DB, exact combined wipe/import and browser evidence
- [ ] Independent reviewer and Rhys decision
